name: randomizer-demo
description: Every @d20dao/vrf-sdk randomness option on Arc, with results stored on-chain and a live UI

paragraphs: A small dapp that requests every randomness option in @d20dao/vrf-sdk 0.4.0 from the published D20DAO coordinator on Arc Mainnet (chain 5042) or Arc Testnet (chain 5042002). The contract stores the latest fulfilled result for each option and the last 20 fulfilled results. The page reads that stored state every few seconds, so it shows new results from any wallet as they arrive.
Requests on mainnet spend real USDC: the D20DAO fee (0.02 USDC minimum) plus gas. Check requests on the D20DAO Explorer.
This is example code, not audited, and has no application payments, eligibility rules or access control beyond the randomness fee.
features: contracts/D20Playground.sol: the consumer contract. It extends D20VRFConsumer, has one payable function per option, and exposes read functions for the stored results.
frontend/index.html: a single-page UI. It has a network selector, a live view of stored results, a wallet request flow, and refund and retry actions.
frontend/deployments.json: the contract address for each chain id, written by the deploy script.
scripts/: compile, pre-flight check, keyless live dry run, deploy and serve.
test/: a local end-to-end test with a mock coordinator.

requirements.text: Static files never invoke the Worker, and relayed pages poll every 8 seconds and pause in background tabs. npm run serve provides the same relay locally. wrangler.jsonc binds it to mainnet-demo.d20dao.org; change name and routes for your own domain, and run npx wrangler login first.
If your login has more than one Cloudflare account, set CLOUDFLAREACCOUNTID.
